general_findings: Historical controls make large improvements clear: fixed objective placement, raised models, contextual terrain and textured fire replace floating labels, flat pads, hard rectangular wakes and circle effects.
Recent foam changes reduce regular short dashes using wider tapered strokes, but offshore strips remain disconnected from beach and material interaction; same score band retained.
Dark deck edge better separates some fittings than pale outline, but neither resolves aircraft/deck overlap.
Terrain variety is useful, yet soft dark tree shadows, flat apron/grass and dense water still have uneven material complexity.
largest_remaining_gaps: Player ring locates center but crowded scenes obscure actual plane silhouette.
Foam does not break, spread or interact convincingly with shallows; ship wakes remain repeated puffs.
Surface shading and material transitions remain simple compared with reference lighting and environmental layering.
recommendations: Integrate irregular foam patches into wet beach/shallow color with uneven width and opacity.
Preserve player shape over deck and overlapping enemies.
Improve local material variation and contact shading before adding more detail.
